verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile MFA, passwordless and passkey app; it has no user-built automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Its account backup and restore (cloud backup of OTP accounts) is a different capability and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
